  • 日本語名: 皇帝陛下になろう！
  • 英語名: Koutei Heika ni Narou!

あらすじ

While our king was visiting his dying teacher, he found and released a girl sealed in a tree. It seems his teacher had sealed her because she came from the underworld. What he released was just her spirit. To get her body back, he has to find medals that his teacher gave to other kings. Well, he has four commanders to help him do that. He can also get some princesses too, if he want to.

item.title: ROSE BLOOD ~Chi no Kawaki~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Aaru
  • 発売日: 1996-09-13
  • スコア: 6.29/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ＲＯＳＥ ＢＬＯＯＤ ～血の渇き～
  • 英語名: ROSE BLOOD Chi no Kawaki

别名

  • サスペンスアドベンチャー -ローズブラッド血の乾き-

あらすじ

Hiiragi Retsu is a private detective. He works in his tiny agency with his fiancee Mizuki as an assistant. One day his office building neighbour, a doctor named Kei, introduces him to a client - a woman who was just raped named Reiko. She wants Retsu to find the perpetrator because the police are ineffective. It turns out, not only other women were attacked, but all of them are from the same high school class as Retsu, Mizuki, Reiko, and Kei. Find the culprit in this detective investigation.
